# ADR-0020: Separate cluster operations from environment and business controls

Recorded: 16 October 2026. Implemented development decision; standalone production design remains proposed; not a bank governance approval.

## Status

Accepted for the trusted development lab; production lifecycle automation proposed

## Context

Operators need to manage CockroachDB clusters without conflating database nodes, supporting infrastructure, legal entities or sovereign business policies. The existing lab has four independent single-node stores on one host.

## Decision

Provide a cluster-first live console with Overview, Nodes, Recovery and Activity, and a separately navigated Environment view. Register targets server-side; allow only health checks and native synthetic canary backup/restore. Persist jobs and management audit atomically in each cluster, with a per-cluster worker independent of the business lock. Interrupted running mutations require inspection instead of automatic replay. The initial adapter shares the trusted loopback API.

## Alternatives

A static/mock control console; unrestricted Docker or SQL administration; replacing the Compose lab with Kubernetes; treating the hosted Continuum control plane as locally installed.

## Consequences

Real SQL and native recovery are inspectable without changing business data or source exclusion rules. The controller is logically separated but not independently deployed or highly available. Node-local canary backups are not business backups or off-host DR. Operator identity, secure regional agents, external backups, standalone management storage and safe multi-node lifecycle adapters remain production work. Known native receipts awaiting SQL journaling are retained in the live regional worker and flushed before new work without replaying native SQL. Simultaneous SQL outage and controller process loss can still lose unjournaled receipts and requires native-job/artifact inspection. Uncertain enqueue acknowledgements require retrying the same request UUID; the page retains it per cluster and operation.

## Evidence

poc/cluster_control/service.py; web/clusters/index.html; poc/tests/cluster_control_acceptance.py; poc/tests/cluster_control_browser.py; docs/CLUSTER_CONTROL.md

## Gate

Execute cluster-test, cluster-faults and real Chromium UX acceptance on the exact commit, retain native BACKUP/RESTORE and journal evidence, and rerun business/pilot acceptance. Before a pilot, validate regional TLS/identity, supported node lifecycle workflows, restore fencing, off-host RPO/RTO and management-plane outage behavior. Existing security CVE gates remain blocking. Include both post-step and terminal journal-write loss with known receipts, truthful failed-health observations, real committed HTTP acknowledgement loss and UUID reuse, mobile accessible navigation and unavailable aggregate history.
